description: This Swift source file defines data structures and a class managing the nodes in the application, including fetching node list data asynchronously, handling errors, and maintaining node state.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the list of nodes, periodically refreshes the node list, and handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh of the node list, incrementing the start count.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh if no other start calls are active.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous fetch of node list data from the server, updating internal state based on success or failure.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks whether a given error is a cancellation-related error.
